ActionDecision.description: The policy layer's verdict on a proposal.
ActionDecision.title: ActionDecision

ActionExecution.description: The result of executing an approved proposal.
ActionExecution.title: ActionExecution

ActionProposal.description:
An action the agent wants to take. Every state mutation begins here.

``capability`` references the manifest-declared capability the
agent claims is sufficient to execute this action; the policy
layer cross-checks.
ActionProposal.title: ActionProposal

AgentArtifact.description: A persisted output of an agent run — narrative, chart, plan.
AgentArtifact.title: AgentArtifact

AgentEvent.description:
One event in the agent timeline.

Streamed over Server-Sent Events to ``apps/web``'s agent activity
feed; persisted as the audit trail. The dashboard reads this
shape directly via the generated TS client.
AgentEvent.title: AgentEvent

AgentRun.description: One execution of an agent. The aggregate root for the lifecycle.
AgentRun.title: AgentRun

AgentSpec.description:
An agent's declared identity. Loaded from the plugin manifest.

Process-level metadata, not user data — does not extend
:class:`WithOwnership`.
AgentSpec.title: AgentSpec

Annotation.description: A point or range marker on a chart — anomaly, intervention, event.
Annotation.title: Annotation

ChartSpec.description:
Declarative chart spec — what to render, not how.

The web app maps this to whichever chart library is current
(Recharts/ECharts/Tremor); swapping the library is a ``apps/web``
job, not a contract change.
ChartSpec.title: ChartSpec

Claim.description: One assertion inside a narrative, with optional evidence + uncertainty.
Claim.title: Claim

Confounder.description:
A competing explanation the engine already accounts for or flags.

Mirrors the context-suppression rules in the detectors (workout-window HR
spikes, post-workout HRV drops, the sleep window) so a card can say *why* a
reading might not mean what it looks like.
Confounder.title: Confounder

Coverage.description:
Data sufficiency behind the finding — the ``gates.py`` verdict, surfaced.

A finding is only emitted once its producer's sufficiency gate passed, so
``is_sufficient`` is typically ``True``; ``note`` records the threshold that
was cleared (e.g. "≥14 observations over ≥7 days"). ``days_until_sufficient``
is only meaningful on the not-yet-analyzable path a future producer might
surface.
Coverage.title: Coverage

Device.description: A physical or logical device emitting samples for a Source.
Device.title: Device

EffectSize.description:
How big the effect is, method-tagged so the UI can label it honestly.

``kind`` names the statistic (``z_score`` / ``spearman_rho`` /
``slope_per_day`` / ``cohens_d`` …) so a reader never confuses a correlation
coefficient with a standardized mean difference. ``p_value`` rides alongside
the magnitude (significance ≠ size) rather than being a separate top-level
card field.
EffectSize.title: EffectSize

EvidenceRef.description: A pointer to a piece of evidence backing a claim.
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

ExperimentCandidateRef.description:
Machine hook linking ``next_question`` to the experiments surface.

Deliberately speaks the ``/api/v2/experiments/candidates`` vocabulary
(metric pair + lever/outcome/verdict/protocol from the readiness classifier)
so the client can hand this straight to ``POST /api/v2/experiments`` with no
parallel schema. Invented nothing new — this is the candidate shape the
experiment engine already ranks.
ExperimentCandidateRef.title: ExperimentCandidateRef

FindingCard.description:
The versioned content model for one evidence-linked finding.

``claim`` / ``metric`` / ``schema_version`` are required; everything else is
optional so legacy or thin findings are represented without fabrication.
FindingCard.title: FindingCard

IngestionError.description: One error captured during an IngestionRun. Append-only.
IngestionError.title: IngestionError

IngestionRun.description: One execution of a Source plugin pulling/receiving data.
IngestionRun.title: IngestionRun

Insight.description:
A structured observation about the user's data.

Severity matches the existing ``analysis.types.Severity`` literal so
the v1 statistical engine output round-trips cleanly into v2 narratives.
Insight.title: Insight

Measurement.description:
The canonical health measurement.

Time-instant samples set ``interval_start == interval_end``.
Time-interval samples (sleep stages, workouts, ECG) set both.
Measurement.title: Measurement

NarrativeArtifact.description:
A streamable narrative — daily briefing, weekly summary, etc.

The wire shape is the *persisted* form. Streaming chunks go over
SSE during render; once complete, the whole artifact is one row
in this shape. The dashboard's ``BriefingCard`` reads this.
NarrativeArtifact.title: NarrativeArtifact

NarrativeCard.description:
A composed UI card — chart + briefing inline.

The load-bearing primitive of the agent-platform UX: chart and
its narrative ship in one HTTP/SSE response, not two requests.
NarrativeCard.title: NarrativeCard

NextQuestion.description: The flywheel field: prose + an optional promotable experiment candidate.
NextQuestion.title: NextQuestion

NormalizedMeasurement.description:
One canonical sample after a Source plugin has parsed it.

Wraps a :class:`Measurement` and pins the raw payload it derives
from. The split lets us evolve normalization independently of the
canonical wire shape.
NormalizedMeasurement.title: NormalizedMeasurement

Observation.description:
What the agent observed during a run. Append-only.

Findings are intentionally a free-form ``dict`` to keep the
contract stable across narrators evolving their statistical
output shape.
Observation.title: Observation

PluginCapability.description:
A capability a plugin declares it needs.

Capabilities use the ``read:<scope>`` / ``write:<scope>`` form
(e.g. ``read:hrv``, ``write:notifications``) so the policy layer
can match on prefix.
PluginCapability.title: PluginCapability

PluginManifest.description:
Every plugin's plugin.yaml validates against this.

``sdk_version`` is the SDK version range the plugin targets
(semver, e.g. ``">=0.1,<0.2"``). The loader rejects plugins
whose declared range doesn't include the running core SDK.
Adding this from day one means we can evolve the SDK contract
without silently breaking community plugins.
PluginManifest.title: PluginManifest

Provenance.description:
Always-attached "where did this come from" capsule.

``raw_payload_ref`` is opaque — typically a row id in
``raw_ingestion_log`` so a future replay can reach the exact
bytes. Storage detail intentionally lives on the other side of
the storage port.
Provenance.title: Provenance

RawSourcePayload.description:
A payload as the source plugin received it, pre-normalization.

Persisted before parsing so we can replay against new normalization
code without re-fetching. ``payload_hash`` is sha256 of the canonical
JSON form for dedup + idempotency.
RawSourcePayload.title: RawSourcePayload

SeriesResponse.description:
Time-series data for a chart, plus annotations.

``points`` is ``(timestamp, value)`` pairs — typed as a list of
two-element tuples so the TS codegen produces a sensible
``[string, number][]`` rather than an opaque object.
SeriesResponse.title: SeriesResponse

Source.description: A source of health data — Apple HealthKit, Oura, manual log, etc.
Source.title: Source

SourceCapability.description:
What a Source plugin claims it can produce.

Declared in the plugin manifest; used by the ingestion runtime
for scheduling and by the dashboard for "available sources" UI.
SourceCapability.title: SourceCapability

SourceRef.description: Where the underlying data came from (provenance, at card granularity).
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

SuggestedAction.description:
A user-visible suggestion. Defaults to requiring approval —
suggestions are advisory, not auto-actuated.
SuggestedAction.title: SuggestedAction

Uncertainty.description: How sure the narrator is about a claim.
Uncertainty.title: Uncertainty

WindowRef.description: A time window a finding is measured over (current or baseline).
WindowRef.title: WindowRef
